title: Indian Standard Specification / Test Method (IS IS_10232)
clause_1_scope: This part of ISO 6887 defines general rules for the aerobic preparation of the initial suspension and of decimal dilutions for microbiological examinations of products intended for human or animal consumption. This part of ISO 6887 is applicable to the general case, except for products mentioned in ISO 6887-2.

marking_requirements: Each container, package or piece shall be marked indelibly with the manufacturer's name, brand/trademark, grade, batch number, and month/year of manufacture.
The product may also be marked with the Standard Mark (BIS Certification Mark) governed by the Bureau of Indian Standards Act.
